label: TEACHER · PREPARED ALEXANDRIA LESSON
text: What if a history lesson became a place you could investigate? This is Counterfactual Worlds.

label: STUDENT · CHANGE ONE ASSUMPTION
text: The teacher starts with a prepared Alexandria lesson. Students explore the city, then change one assumption: what if harbor trade collapsed?

label: STUDENT · REAL ASTRA FEEDBACK
text: A student predicts the library will definitely close. Astra challenges that certainty and asks what the evidence supports.

label: TEACHER · PREVIEW AND APPLY
text: The teacher adds a new challenge: could another patron support the scholars? We preview the question, then add it to the same student world.

label: STUDENT · READ AND CITE
text: Students read Strabo inside the app, distinguish historical evidence from invented teaching props, and cite the source.

label: STUDENT · REVISE THE EXPLANATION
text: The revised explanation connects trade, income, and scholar support, while recognizing that another patron could change the outcome.
